alerts.area: Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma; Buttonwillow - Lost Hills - I5; Delano-Wasco-Shafter; Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore
alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 21 at 9:56AM PST until November 21 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter to one half mile in dense fog.

* WHERE...Buttonwillow - Lost Hills - I5, Caruthers - San Joaquin -
Selma, Delano-Wasco-Shafter, and Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore.

* WHEN...Until noon PST today.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
